latin: Tria transcendentia in quibus consistit imago non dicunt diuersas rationes in recto, et principaliter diffinibiles uel descriptibiles.
translation: The three transcendentals that make up the image do not properly amount to distinct concepts, above all ones open to definition or description.
translation_note: 'the image' = the image of the three divine Persons in the human soul; parallels 4>5.
